card.line: The Skull is the place outside Jerusalem where Jesus was crucified between two criminals, as told in Luke's account of His death.

moments.title: Jesus is crucified
moments.text: At the place called The Skull, they crucified Jesus with two criminals, one on His right and one on His left. Jesus said, "Father, forgive them, for they do not know what they are doing."

moments.title: The crowd mocks the King
moments.text: The rulers and soldiers sneered at Jesus and told Him to save Himself. A sign above Him read, "THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS." One of the criminals also heaped abuse on Him.
